name: [HARDCORE💥] Robloxia Tower Defense
desc:
Defend Robloxia!

Robloxia Tower Defense is a TD game where you, as a fellow Robloxian, fullfill your duty by defending the nation and our great leader Builderman against all kinds of riots and invasions!

Level up, earn cash, unlock new towers and most importantly: Become Robloxia's greatest hero!

Leave a like 👍 and maybe even a favorite 🌟 if you're feeling really patriotic so everyone gets to fullfill their duty which is, again:

To defend Robloxia!



Update 08/07:
- new hc mode
- new currency

- 4 new stage 4 towers:
 - industry(stage 4 corp)
 - scammer(stage 4 boss)
 - pupil(stage 4 recruit)
 - trap IV(stage 4 trap)

- new lobby
- new daily & weekly missions(=> new way to get tokens, *replacing the afk place*)
- reworked ui
- reworked trap(now stuns and deals critical hits on max lvl)
- reworked chill tower

+more

08/13:
the game was discontinued
